card.name: The word year and its forms
card.fires_on: The word year or a year-based form such as yearly, annum or the ending of Tahun, usually in phrases about a yearly span or frequency like 'throughout the year' or 'per annum'.

modes.label: Year after a time phrase
modes.description: The word year or annum finishing a phrase about duration or frequency.

modes.label: Yearly forms
modes.description: Yearly or year- forms that mean once per year.
modes.example: We recommend<< yearly>> eye examinations, available at any registered Opt

modes.label: Year word in other languages
modes.description: Part of a year word in Indonesian or French, such as Tahun or Année.
modes.example: BUKU INI DI TULIS PADA TAH<<UN>> 1869 OLEH

card.plain: It lights up on the word year, or yearly, when text talks about something happening each year or all year.
